ambiguities.source_text: If a customer appears multiple times take their earliest joining date
ambiguities.intent: Keep the earliest Joining Date per customer ID using chronological date ordering.
Retain one deterministic record when earliest dates tie; sorting by the same ID alone is not an additional tie discriminator.
ambiguities.source_text: If there is a tie on earliest joining date, keep a single deterministic record (e.g., by stable ordering on **ID**).

ambiguities.intent: Take the first available value for repeated customer/joining-date/demographic rows.
ambiguities.source_text: When pivoting, if multiple rows exist for the same customer/joining date/demographic, take the first available value for that demographic.
Stack (union) all monthly tables on top of one another because they share the same logical fields.
ambiguities.intent: Union monthly tables by corresponding field names, merging the misspelled demographic column names as required in query.
Preserve union fields absent from a particular source as null.
ambiguities.source_text: Align fields by name when unioning; fields that do not exist in a given month should be left null for that month’s rows.
